{{Quote|I assure you, my intentions are entirely honorable&mdash;as honorable as a Hutt can manage&mdash;|Gorga|<ref name="Bar-Kooda" />}}
'''Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo''' was the nephew of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], and a powerful [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] of the [[Desilijic/Legends|Desilijic]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]] in his own right. Around the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he became the [[Kajidii/Legends|leader]] of his clan, along with Jabba, and represented it on the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Ruling Council]]. Eventually, after his uncle's [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon|death]], Gorga took over his criminal empire and expanded it farther than even Jabba himself ever did.

During the [[Rebellion era|Rebellion]]/[[New Republic era]], Gorga married [[Anachro]], the daughter of [[Orko]] the [[H'uun]], and had [[Gorga's son|one Huttlet]] with her.

==Biography==
Gorga was born at an unknown date on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] to an unknown sibling of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], an infamous [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] who controlled a [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|major criminal empire]] in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. At some point in his life, Gorga became the [[Kajidii/Legends|leader]] of the [[Desilijic/Legends|Desilijic]] [[Kajidic/Legends|clan]]&mdash;along with Jabba&mdash;and earned a position on the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Ruling Council]]. Despite being Jabba's nephew, Gorga's voice was given equal measure on matters brought before the council though it was not as weighty as Jabba's.<ref name="GTH" />

Sometime during or prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Gorga established a black market operation on the planet [[Nothoiin/Legends|Nothoiin]], which lasted for years and brought Gorga huge profits.<ref name="Runaway Ride">{{TCWComicCite|6.50|The Runaway Ride}}</ref>

===Time in the Clone Wars===
[[File:HuttGrandCouncil-EP.png|thumb|left|250px|Gorga, at left, serves on the Hutt Grand Council during the Clone Wars.]]
{{Quote|For years ''Nothoiin'' was the center of a very profitable black market operation! But now, after one month with your clones, I'm suddenly out of business!|Gorga, to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Runaway Ride" />}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Ruling Council]] hired [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] to hunt for [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro]] the Hutt, due to his possession of potentially damaging information about Hutt activities.<ref name="HFZ" /><ref name="SWI121">[[Star Wars Insider 121|''Star Wars Insider'' 121]]</ref> At that time, the council consisted of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo, [[Arok/Legends|Arok Besadii]], [[Oruba/Legends|Oruba]], and [[Marlo/Legends|Marlo Qunaalac]].

Several months later, Gorga traveled to the planet [[Zygerria/Legends|Zygerria]] to browse its slave markets. While he was inspecting the captured slaves, Gorga shoved a nearby [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian guard]] and voiced his disappointment in the selection of slaves completely unaware the guard was in reality [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] who was undercover to find kidnapped [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] colonists.<ref name="SH">{{TCW|Slaves of the Republic}}</ref>

A short time later, Gorga visited the [[Bilbousa Bazaar/Legends|Bilbousa Bazaar]] along with two female [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] slaves who hung onto the Hutt's arms. As he made his way down the main street, Gorga smirked as he saw several of the locals being harassed by the [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] guards the Hutts employed. Once again, Gorga passed by a disguised Obi-Wan Kenobi, this time pretending to be the wanted [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardeen]].

[[File:GorgaBilbousa-FAE.png|thumb|Gorga at the Bilbousa Bazaar]]
A [[20 BBY/Legends|year later]], [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]], and [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]] of the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] came to the [[Hutt Council Chamber/Legends|Hutt Council Chamber]] in a [[Gardulla the Hutt's Palace/Legends|Hutt Palace]] to form an alliance with the elder Hutts. Maul asked for [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt territories]] and everything in it's borders, in exchange for the Hutts' lives. They merely laughed, and Jabba sent bounty hunters after them. While Gorga and Jabba were seen as holograms, the other Hutts, except for Oruba, escaped. Gorga was later seen with Jabba at [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|his uncle's palace]], when Maul and [[Shadow Collective/Legends|company]] launched an [[Attack on Jabba's Palace/Legends|attack]] on Jabba's palace. Gorga watched as his uncle was forced to join the Collective.

Sometime later, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Liberation of Nothoiin|brought]] the Clone Wars to [[Nothoiin/Legends|Nothoiin]], ending in a Republic victory, which resulted in Gorga going out of business. Gorga then hired several [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]] mercenaries, nicknamed [[Team Dosho]], and a bounty hunter named [[Zatch (bounty hunter)|Zatch]]. The bounty hunters disguised themselves as [[Nothoiin (species)/Legends|Nothoiins]] and stole [[Nothoiin swoop]]s. Gorga then had the Trandoshans [[Ambush of the Goldskin Parade|attack]] the captured [[Separatist Heavy Speeder]] carrying [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and Obi-Wan Kenobi. Gorga soon contacted the [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] and told them that he was trying to cause a civil war on Nothoiin to bring back his business to the planet. However, Zatch was soon defeated and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] rammed their speeder into Gorga's [[Unidentified vehicle (Nothoiin)|vehicle]]. Gorga was then arrested by the Jedi and taken to a Republic prison.<ref name="Runaway Ride" />

Sometime later, Gorga was freed from prison and traveled to the base of the [[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|Pyke Syndicate]] on [[Oba Diah/Legends|Oba Diah]]. He was seen in the throne room of Minister [[Lom Pyke/Legends|Lom Pyke]], along with fellow [[Kajidii/Legends|Kajidii]] Arok during Jedi Generals Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi's visit.<ref name="TLO">{{TCW|The Lost One}}</ref>

===Jabba's treasure===
After Jabba's death, Gorga had already been released from Republic prison and sought to take possession of his late uncle's treasure ship ''[[Spirit of Jabba]]'' and all the valuable objects on board. However, [[Gizman]] and [[Spiker]], former [[Swoop/Legends|Swoop]] riders for Jabba, reached the vessel first and took off. They were waylaid briefly by a [[Jabba Tape|security holotape]], giving one of Gorga's armed freighters a chance to catch up. In an effort to lighten the vessel's load and escape, as well as strike back at Gorga (whom they suspected had something to do with the tape triggering), Gizman and Spiker flew low and threw Jabba's priceless collection of [[Mendacian Funeral Urns]] at the Hutt. The loss of one of the most valuable treasures aboard the ship horrified Gorga.

===Hiring Boba Fett===
[[File:Urnsjabba.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Jabba's funeral urns are dropped on Gorga.]]
While on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], a Hutt named [[Anachro]] caught Gorga's eye. Gorga found her to be beautiful. Unfortunately for him, Anachro was the daughter of [[Orko]] the [[H'uun]], an enemy of his. Deciding that a gift might placate Orko, Gorga hired [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] to kill [[Bar-Kooda]], a pirate kingpin that had been harassing Orko's freighters. Fett succeeded, and Gorga, [[Anachro]], and [[Orko]] celebrated Gorga and Anachro's impending nuptials by eating Bar-Kooda's corpse.

While on his honeymoon, [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] kidnapped Anachro on [[Skeebo]], causing Gorga to hire Fett to get her back. Orko accused Gorga of staging the event, and the two Hutts might have come to blows, had Fett not arrived with Anachro. Gorga and Orko made a public reconciliation. However, Gorga soon found his father-in-law insufferable.

He hired Fett to assassinate Orko, but asked him to make it look accidental, so that Anachro's suspicions were not aroused. However, when he learned that Anachro was pregnant, he ordered the assassination called off. Unfortunately, [[Ry-Kooda]], Bar-Kooda's brother, had murdered Orko in a particularly brutal fashion. Anachro accused Gorga of the murder, and in grief went back to her father's. Ry-Kooda attacked Anachro's transport, but Gorga stopped him, and Boba Fett ultimately killed Ry-Kooda. The turmoil of the event caused Anachro to give birth.

===Profitable business ventures===
Boba Fett's charges put Gorga in debt for two years, but his shrewd business skills paid off. Gorga managed to attain quite a fortune, including casinos, restaurants, and [[Smuggler/Legends|"cargo haulers"]]. His family life was also prosperous and happy. Gorga sold precious [[ulikuo gemstone]]s from [[Kip]] on the black market with a silent partner. He thought that his wife didn't know about this, but she of course did, being more keen and ambitious than she seemed. Gorga also had a [[Palace of Gorga the Hutt|palace]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] very similar to his late uncle's.

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Gorga_the_Hutt.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Gorga the Hutt]]
{{Quote|There will ''always'' be war, and I will ''always'' profit from the conflict.|Gorga|<ref name="Runaway Ride" />}}
Gorga was a money watching and scheming [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] of the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Council]]. Gorga was fully aware of the scheming nature that the Hutts took deep pride in. Gorga ably accounted for skimming along with outright theft while ensuring the criminal enterprise remained able to thrive. Gorga regularly met with his fellow Hutt councilors in the halls of the Hutt Council on the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] homeworld of [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], where he stood by closely to his uncle, [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]].<ref name="GTH" />

Gorga had an average [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] build, standing at 2.11 meters in height,<ref name="GTH" /> and 3.7 meters in length.<ref name="Magazine 21" /> Gorga appeared to have a squarish head with tan and green skin.<ref name="HFZ" />

==Equipment==
During the Clone Wars, Gorga wore an unique headset that was a combination of a speaker and monocle.<ref name="Explore: Friends and Enemies">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep416|text="Friends and Enemies" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}} First identified as a monocle.</ref> The monocle was placed over his right eye and both it and the comlink<ref name="Magazine 21" /> where hinged so they could be rotated. The monocle's lens would often give Gorga's eye a distorted look.

==Behind the scenes==
He is voiced by [[Kevin Michael Richardson]] in ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''.

Gorga was also identified in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Magazine 9|9th edition]] of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Magazine]] as [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba's]] nephew. Also, in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Magazine 21|21st edition]], the magazine states [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] as Gorga's homeworld, whereas his homeworld is actually [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], which is stated on the official Star Wars website.
